symptom: Repair v18 passed the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix, but failed the 300s / 10-seed expansion. Idle 0.0%, Random 0.0%, Coward 10.0%, Tank 50.0%, BossHunter 50.0%, and ZoneControl 30.0% stayed inside target bands. Greedy reached 70.0%, Kite reached 80.0%, and Route reached 40.0%, all above their configured upper bounds.
root_cause: The v18 0.01 ranged-pressure restoration was enough to make the first three seeds look healthy, but the wider seed range still leaves the 210-300 second recovery window too safe for greedy pickup, high-skill kiting, and fixed-route movement. Coward sits exactly at the 10.0% lower bound, so the next repair cannot simply add broad pressure everywhere without risking low-skill underperformance.
fix: Do not promote v18 to simulated or playtest candidates. Create v19 as a generated candidate that adds a narrower anti-route / anti-kite pressure adjustment, preferably by moving a small amount of safe or slow-blocker weight in the 210-300 second segment into readable ranged or side-pressure enemies while preserving Coward's single recovery win. Avoid changing player weapons, passives, boss stats, early segments, or Harness gate thresholds.
validation: Rerun the candidate static chain, then rerun the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix and the 300s / 10-seed all-Bot expansion. A viable repair must keep Coward between 10%-35%, Greedy and Tank between 25%-55%, Kite and BossHunter between 45%-75%, Route between 10%-35%, and Idle / Random within their floor bands before Replay regression or human review.
